clue.text: Popular officer, usually

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable
a general is a senior army officer

explanation.surface: A well-liked military officer, as is normally the case.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means as a rule or for the most part, a synonym of normally.

clue.text: Cove with home to lease

parts.note: in means at home
to let is to lease out

explanation.surface: A bay with a house available to rent.
explanation.definitionFit: An inlet is a small arm of the sea, like a cove.

clue.text: Racing vehicles have gear-wheel mounted with various techniques

indicators.note: in a down clue, mounted means turned upwards, read from the bottom

parts.note: a cog is a toothed gear-wheel
arts are skills or techniques

explanation.surface: Racing cars carry gears fitted using several methods.
explanation.definitionFit: Go-carts, or karts, are small low vehicles raced on tracks.

clue.text: See maddened gnat annoy farm animal

indicators.note: maddened means driven wild, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Watch an angry insect pester livestock.
explanation.definitionFit: A female goat is an animal kept on farms.

clue.text: Some confectionery and bread may be needed for dance

parts.note: rock is a hard stick of sweet confectionery sold at British seaside resorts
a roll is a small loaf of bread

explanation.surface: Sweets and bread might be required for a party.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1950s music style also names the energetic dance done to it.

clue.text: Drink friend brought up

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: A mate's drink is served.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' turns PAL into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To lap is to drink by scooping with the tongue, as a cat does.

clue.text: Rachel's husband gets bill in the post

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the word for the post

parts.note: a post is a position of employment, a job
AC is the abbreviation for account, a bill

explanation.surface: Rachel's spouse finds an invoice arriving with the mail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The post' suggests mail but means a job.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis the patriarch worked fourteen years to marry Rachel, so he is her biblical spouse.

clue.text: Initially, judge usually relies on reasonable person to deliver verdict

indicators.note: initially means the opening letters of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: At the start, a judge normally trusts a sensible individual to give a ruling.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a jury delivers the verdict in a trial.

clue.text: Rioting I cannot keep within bounds

indicators.note: rioting means running wild, so the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: A protester admits being unable to restrain the riot.
explanation.definitionFit: To contain is to restrain or hold in check, keeping something within limits.

clue.text: Riga's been rebuilt, the Russian border being fluid

indicators.note: rebuilt means put together again differently, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The Latvian capital has been reconstructed while the frontier with Russia keeps shifting.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: the Bering Sea borders Russia, and as water it is a fluid border.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bering Sea lies along Russia's far-eastern coast, a watery frontier.

clue.text: In short, resin nearly all kept in readiness

parts.note: lac is a resin secreted by insects, used for shellac

indicators.note: the phrase is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: on ice means held back ready for later use

explanation.surface: Briefly, most of the resin was stored ready for use.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly all' drops the final E of ON ICE, leaving ONIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Laconic speech is terse, using very few words, so the clue phrase for brevity fits it.

clue.text: Setback for ruse that's no use to snare a husband

clue.text: Delay attempt to contain a river

indicators.note: the word for attempt holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: Postponing an effort to dam a waterway.
explanation.definitionFit: To tarry is to linger or dawdle, the verb sense of delaying.

clue.text: Discover sectarian's alter ego

indicators.note: a word's alter ego here is its other self, the same letters rearranged

parts.note: the possessive adds no letters

explanation.surface: Uncovering the hidden other personality of a bigot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'alter ego' reads as a second self but signals that the letters of SECTARIAN are reorganised.
explanation.definitionFit: To ascertain is to find out for certain, a synonym of discover.

clue.text: Interrelated families set apart in secret

parts.note: a clan is a group of interrelated families
to destine is to set apart for a purpose

explanation.surface: Related households kept separate in secret.
explanation.definitionFit: Something clandestine is done covertly, in secrecy.

clue.text: Man's delivering greetings

definitions.meaning: belonging to a man, the male possessive pronoun
saying hello, hi after hi, more than once

explanation.surface: A chap is saying hello to people.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the male possessive pronoun and the plural of a casual hello.

clue.text: Keeps bird inside on the return journey

indicators.note: the bird is placed within the word for keeps

parts.note: hoards means keeps or stores away
a mew is a gull

explanation.surface: A man retains a bird indoors while travelling back.
explanation.definitionFit: Homewards means going towards home, the direction of a journey back.

clue.text: Job lot consisting of strange grains runs out

parts.note: odd means strange
sand is made up of grains
ends means comes to an end, runs out

explanation.surface: A batch of goods made up of peculiar seeds is exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: A job lot is a miscellaneous bundle of items, just as the phrase means assorted leftovers.

clue.text: Book produced by dreadful pair of conservatives

parts.note: dire means dreadful
C is the abbreviation for Conservative
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A volume written by two awful right-wing politicians.
explanation.definitionFit: A directory is a reference book listing names and addresses.

clue.text: Customised plant, not fully established, brought back inside

indicators.note: the reversed fragment goes inside the plant's name

parts.note: madder is a plant grown for its red dye

indicators.note: brought back means turned round, read backwards
the word loses its final letter, so it is not complete

parts.note: rooted means firmly established

explanation.surface: A tailored plant, not yet properly settled, was returned indoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not fully' cuts ROOTED to ROOTE; 'brought back' turns it into ETOOR, which goes 'inside' MADDER.
explanation.definitionFit: Something customised is built to a buyer's specification, which is what the phrase means.

clue.text: Dennis is entered in several races -he looks down in the mouth

definitions.text: he looks down in the mouth

parts.note: Den is a short form of Dennis

indicators.note: the word is placed inside the races

parts.note: the TT is a series of motorcycle races on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: A man called Dennis has signed up for several races and looks glum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'down in the mouth' means gloomy, but here it is literal: a dentist peers down into patients' mouths.
explanation.definitionFit: A dentist looks down into the patient's mouth to examine teeth.

clue.text: Stole a snake

definitions.meaning: a feather or fur wrap worn round the neck

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a long scarf of feathers or fur and a constrictor snake.

clue.text: City Zoo's inhabitant

definitions.meaning: a city in New York State
a large wild ox kept in a zoo

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an American city on Lake Erie and a bison or wild ox.

clue.text: Alec's news disturbed Bohemian

indicators.note: disturbed means thrown into disorder, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive apostrophe is ignored, giving nine letters

explanation.surface: A man named Alec was upset by some news.
explanation.definitionFit: Good King Wenceslas of the carol was a Duke of Bohemia, so he is a Bohemian.

clue.text: Edit pieces submitted to the editor

indicators.note: the pieces are handed in to the editor, going inside the abbreviation

parts.note: ED is the abbreviation for editor
men are chess or draughts pieces

explanation.surface: Revise the articles sent in to the newspaper chief.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend is to correct or revise a text, as an editor does.

clue.text: Rings round to restrain strikes

definitions.meaning: handcuffs, metal rings that restrain wrists
blows, or hits with the hand

explanation.definitionFit: The plural noun means both handcuffs and light blows struck with the hand.

clue.text: Off-colour? Spot has a lot of colour

parts.note: to spot is to see

indicators.note: most of the word is used, losing its last letter

parts.note: a dye colours

explanation.surface: Unwell? A blemish is highly coloured.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling seedy means being slightly unwell, out of sorts or off-colour.

clue.text: Clothing — artist has people wearing it

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

indicators.note: the first word goes around the people as if wearing them

parts.note: men means people

explanation.surface: A painter has his subjects dressed in the garment.
explanation.definitionFit: Raiment is an old literary word for garments, a synonym of clothing.

clue.text: Draw a line above notes

definitions.meaning: a curved line joining two musical notes of the same pitch

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a drawn game and also the musical curve binding notes together.

clue.text: One extremely tardy is set apart

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
so means very or extremely
late means tardy

explanation.surface: Someone very late is kept away from the others.
explanation.definitionFit: To isolate is to separate from others, a synonym of set apart.

clue.text: In South Africa, chap given more than enough

parts.note: Ted is a man's name, a chap

explanation.surface: A man in South Africa is overfed.
explanation.definitionFit: Sated means satisfied to the full or glutted, having had plenty or too much.

clue.text: One and all recalled unknown bird circling cowshed

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the whole run is read backwards

parts.note: Y is an algebraic unknown

indicators.note: the bird's letters go around the cowshed

parts.note: a dove is a bird
a byre is a cowshed

explanation.surface: Everyone remembered an unidentified bird flying round a barn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circling' puts BYRE inside DOVE to make DOBYREVE; after Y, 'recalled' turns the whole run backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The pronoun means every person, which is what the phrase one and all expresses.
